mentions.description: An over-engineered console.log replacement for JavaScript debugging, nearly API/feature-stable, named 'gg' for grep-ibility and ease of typing. It ships with an optional dev console, and AI assistants like Claude can insert logging calls and read back client-side results without developer interaction.
